source.title: Dynamics of second order rational difference equations. With open problems and conjectures

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 1640985.

Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/1640985 returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge. Attempts to use the zbMATH REST API for the same identifier were not usable for extraction because local GET requests to api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors; browser access to the API root exposed only the terms entry page rather than full-text content.

Local workflow shard metadata for the same zbMATH identifier records the title as 'Dynamics of second order rational difference equations. With open problems and conjectures' and the year as 2002. Exact-title web recovery also identified matching bibliographic records from Open Library, URI DigitalCommons, Routledge/Taylor & Francis, Perlego, and ResearchGate, including DOI 10.1201/9781420035384 and Internet Archive identifier dynamicssecondor00kule. This metadata was used only for title recovery and exact-work matching, not technical extraction.

Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the zbMATH identifier, the exact recovered title, the exact title plus PDF, and the exact title plus open problems. Open Library exposed the Internet Archive identifier and download-option metadata, but archive.org text/PDF download attempts could not be normalized to a readable local artifact because local DNS resolution for archive.org failed during the bounded pass and the browser fetch did not expose the item text. URI DigitalCommons explicitly stated that the document is not available there. Routledge/Taylor & Francis DOI resolution led to a publisher/eBook page rather than readable full text, with local DOI resolution ending at a Taylor & Francis 503 response. Perlego and ResearchGate candidates were subscription/request-only or metadata/preview pages. No exact-work readable PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.

No readable exact-work primary source artifact was available. The workflow forbids extracting questions from zbMATH/local shard metadata, abstracts, bibliographic records, search snippets, subscription previews, or unavailable download links, so the run is returned as error_input with no accepted questions.
Saved the exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/1640985.json and outputs/latest.json.
